data.description: A halsora's claws are covered in mutated russet mold spores. A creature hit by a claw attack must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or take 2 points of Constitution damage per round. It can attempt a new Fortitude save each round to halt the growth. A creature reduced to 0 Constitution by these spores explodes in a mess of viscera and spores. Creatures within the burst must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude saving throw or be affected as if they were hit by the halsora's claw attack. This is a disease effect.
